
```{r}
setwd('C:/Users/Neo/OneDrive/Documents/Master of Biostats/Research project/simulation result/new decision rule')

all_posteriors <- read.csv("posterior_scenarios_sim.csv")
all_paths_df <- read.csv("all_paths_scenarios.csv")
id70_df <- read.csv("id70_scenarios.csv")
```


```{r}
final_trials <- all_paths_df %>%
  group_by(scenario, sim_id) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = cohort, n=1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

study_summary <- final_trials %>%
  group_by(scenario) %>%
  summarise(
    # the mean study size along with 95% CI
    avg_study_size = mean(total_enrolled),
    study_size_lo95 = quantile(total_enrolled, 0.025),
    study_size_hi95 = quantile(total_enrolled, 0.975),
    
    # mean number of participants in each scenario
    mean_N_at_target = mean(cum_n_at_target_dose, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # median number of cohorts for each scenario
    median_n_cohorts = median(cohort),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )

study_summary
```

```{r}
id70_summary_by_cohort <- id70_df %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  summarise(
    id70_mean = log10(mean(mean)),
    id70_median = log10(median(mean)),
    id70_sd = log10(sd(mean)),
    id70_lo = log10(quantile(mean, 0.025)),
    id70_hi = log10(quantile(mean, 0.975)),
    id70_q1 = log10(quantile(mean, 0.25)),
    id70_q3 = log10(quantile(mean, 0.75)),
    n_trials = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

id70_summary_by_cohort
```
